title: How do you build a training matrix for a law firm?
seoTitle: Training matrix for a law firm
description: Build a law firm training matrix: practice groups against AML, privilege, CPD, privacy and harassment duties by market, with refresh rules and evidence.
shortAnswer: A law firm training matrix lists practice groups and support roles against two kinds of duty: obligations the firm owes as a business, such as anti-money laundering, privacy and harassment prevention, and obligations each lawyer owes to keep a practising certificate, such as annual CPD. Rows should follow the type of matter a person works on, because conveyancing, structuring and trust account work attract duties that litigation usually does not.
keyTakeaways: Split firm delivered rows (AML, privacy, harassment prevention) from practitioner held rows (practising certificate CPD), because the evidence and the accountable person differ.
Matter type decides AML exposure: Australia's table 6 services such as conveyancing, company and trust creation and holding client money are in scope, while litigation generally is not.
Lawyers need a dedicated legal professional privilege module, since a partly privileged suspicion still requires an LPP form lodged with the report.
NSW and Victorian solicitors need 10 CPD units a year across four compulsory fields, with records kept for at least three years and produced within 21 days of an audit.
Key dates include Australia's tranche 2 start on July 1, 2026 and the EU Anti-Money Laundering Regulation applying from July 10, 2027.

sections.heading: What makes a law firm training matrix different from other professional services?

blocks.text: A law firm carries duties at two levels at once: the firm is a reporting entity, employer and data controller, and each lawyer holds a personal practising certificate with its own education condition. A matrix that tracks only firm courses misses the second level, and one that tracks only CPD misses the first.

The general method in [how to build a training matrix](/guides/how-to-build-a-training-matrix) still holds: roles on one axis, obligations on the other, a frequency and evidence rule in every cell. What changes for a law firm is that the rows follow matter types rather than seniority, that one column (privilege) exists nowhere else, and that many cells are verification rows where the firm checks a lawyer's own compliance instead of delivering training. Building the columns from an [obligations to training map](/guides/how-to-map-training-to-compliance-obligations) keeps each one traceable to its rule.

sections.heading: Which law firm roles need their own rows?

blocks.text: Give a separate row to every group whose matters trigger a distinct duty. In Australia, the Australian Transaction Reports and Analysis Centre (AUSTRAC) regulates nine professional services listed in table 6 of the AML/CTF Act, so the practice groups that perform those services are the natural rows.

sections.heading: Which obligations apply to law firms in each market?

blocks.text: The columns come from the library's regulation pages for each market the firm practices in. Each summary below draws only on those pages, and each link opens the full requirement.

items: **Australia, AML/CTF.** Law practices providing table 6 services became reporting entities from July 1, 2026. AUSTRAC says a service is caught even if provided once, alongside other work, or free, so pro bono teams are not automatically outside scope ([AML/CTF tranche 2 for lawyers and accountants](/regulations/aml-ctf-tranche-2-lawyers-accountants-training)). Section 5-9 of the AML/CTF Rules 2025 requires initial and ongoing training appropriate to each person's function and risks ([AUSTRAC AML/CTF training](/regulations/austrac-aml-ctf-training-requirements)).

**Australia, practising certificates.** CPD is a statutory condition on every practising certificate under section 52 of the Legal Profession Uniform Law. NSW solicitors need 10 units per CPD year (April 1 to March 31) with at least one in each compulsory field ([NSW solicitor CPD](/regulations/nsw-solicitor-cpd-requirements)); Victorian lawyers have the same 10 point structure, audited by the Law Institute of Victoria and the Victorian Bar ([Victorian lawyer CPD](/regulations/victoria-lawyer-cpd-requirements)).

**Australia, privacy and conduct.** The Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (OAIC) names regular staff training as a step under APP 1 and APP 11 ([Privacy Act staff training](/regulations/privacy-act-staff-training-requirements)). Section 47C of the Sex Discrimination Act requires reasonable and proportionate measures to eliminate workplace sexual harassment, and the Australian Human Rights Commission expects ongoing, role tailored education ([positive duty](/regulations/positive-duty-sexual-harassment-training)).

**European Union and Portugal.** The EU Anti-Money Laundering Regulation (AMLR) applies from July 10, 2027 and covers lawyers in certain transactions; Article 12 requires specific, ongoing, documented training and Article 13 an assessment of skills and integrity before people take up AML/CFT roles ([EU AMLR](/regulations/eu-amlr-training-requirements)). Until then, Portuguese lawyers, solicitors and notaries in covered activities follow Article 55 of Law 83/2017 ([Portugal AML law](/regulations/portugal-aml-law-training-requirements)). The GDPR requires people with access to personal data to process it only on instructions (Articles 29 and 32(4)) ([GDPR staff training](/regulations/gdpr-staff-training-requirements)).

**United States.** California requires employers with five or more employees to give California staff harassment prevention training every two years, two hours for supervisors and one hour for others; New York requires annual interactive training for every employer ([California and New York harassment training](/regulations/california-and-new-york-harassment-training)).

**Japan.** The Act on the Protection of Personal Information (APPI) Article 24 requires supervision of employees who handle personal data, and the Personal Information Protection Commission's guidelines make employee education a mandatory human security measure ([APPI employee training](/regulations/japan-appi-employee-training)).

**United Arab Emirates.** Lawyers and notaries are designated non-financial businesses and professions when carrying out the listed activities. Article 21(5) of Cabinet Resolution No. 134 of 2025 requires periodic programs and workshops, and Article 22(4) makes the compliance officer responsible for documented training plans ([UAE AML/CFT](/regulations/uae-aml-cft-training-requirements)).

sections.heading: Why does legal professional privilege need its own column?

blocks.text: Because a privilege decision changes what a lawyer must lodge with AUSTRAC, and getting it wrong in either direction is a compliance failure. Section 242(1) of the AML/CTF Act preserves the right to withhold privileged information, but AUSTRAC's guidance attaches conditions that fee earners and partners must apply under time pressure.

items: **Privilege is narrower than confidentiality.** Staff who treat every confidential file as privileged will under report.

**All or part.** If every ground of suspicion is privileged, no suspicious matter report or LPP form is needed. If only part is privileged, the report goes in with an LPP form in place of the withheld information.
**No waiver by description.** Describing the privileged information in the form does not of itself waive privilege, and failing to submit a required form may attract civil penalties.

**Assessment by scenario.** A privilege call is judgment, so the evidence for this column should be worked file scenarios with recorded reasoning, as discussed in [completion tracking vs competency verification](/compare/completion-tracking-vs-competency-verification).

sections.heading: What does a law firm training matrix look like when filled in?

blocks.text: It reads as a list of role and market pairs, each with an obligation, a clock and the evidence the firm keeps. The extract below is illustrative only, for a hypothetical firm with offices in Sydney, Melbourne, Lisbon, New York and Dubai. Where a frequency says firm policy, the cited rule sets no interval and the firm must justify its choice.

sections.heading: How should practising certificate CPD appear on a firm matrix?

blocks.text: As verification rows owned by each lawyer, with the firm checking status rather than issuing completions. The solicitor declares compliance at renewal and answers any audit personally, so the firm's role is to see gaps early and to keep its own in house sessions mapped to the compulsory fields.

items: **Field coverage, not just totals.** Ten units with no ethics unit fails Rule 6 in NSW, so the matrix should show each of the four fields separately.

**Caps.** In NSW, passive audio or video study, writing and presenting are each capped at 5 units and committee work at 3 units, so a lawyer whose units come mostly from recorded webinars may be short.

**Carry over and pro rata.** NSW allows up to 3 units completed between January and March to carry forward; new admissions follow a pro rata table, from 10 units for an April start down to none for February or March, with compulsory fields still covered.

**Rectification.** In Victoria a non compliant lawyer receives a written notice and 90 days to complete a rectification plan, and continued refusal can lead to conditions on the certificate. In NSW, a solicitor who declares non compliance at renewal and has no exemption must lodge a rectification plan under Rule 15.

sections.heading: How often should a law firm refresh each row?

blocks.text: Use the interval the rule states where one exists, and a documented firm policy where it does not. Only a few law firm rules fix a clock; most require ongoing or regular training and leave the cycle to the firm's risk assessment.

blocks.text: Add event triggers next to the dates: a move into a structuring or trust account role, a change to the firm's AML/CTF risk assessment, or a privilege error found in file review. The guide on [setting mandatory training refresh cycles](/guides/how-to-set-mandatory-training-refresh-cycles) covers how to justify a chosen interval.

sections.heading: What evidence should a law firm keep for each row?

blocks.text: Keep proof of understanding where the source asks for it, and the retention period the strictest applicable rule sets. AUSTRAC's good practice firm tests knowledge with quizzes or scenario discussions and logs all training in a central register, which is a sound default for every AML row.

items: **AML records.** Seven years in Portugal under Article 51 of Law 83/2017; five years in the UAE under Article 25 of Cabinet Resolution No. 134 of 2025.
**CPD records.** At least three years under NSW Rule 12, produced within 21 days of an audit; Victorian audits can reach any of the three previous years.

**Harassment prevention records.** At least two years in California; three years for New York City employers with 15 or more employees; attendance with a copy of the content under the AHRC guidelines.

**Privacy evidence.** Training records are a standard part of demonstrating accountability under GDPR Article 5(2), and failure to implement privacy practices and systems is a seriousness factor under Australia's amended Privacy Act.

blocks.text: When one session serves several rows, file it under the longest period. The guide on [evidencing training effectiveness to a regulator](/guides/how-to-evidence-training-effectiveness-to-a-regulator) covers how to present results rather than attendance.

sections.heading: Which dates should a law firm build into its matrix?

blocks.text: Enter these as future dated rows so the affected cells change status on the right day. Each date comes from the linked regulation page, as at November 2026.

items: **April 1, 2026, Australia:** Equality and Wellbeing becomes a mandatory CPD category for barristers.
**July 1, 2026, Australia:** lawyers, conveyancers and trust and company service providers providing table 6 services are regulated by AUSTRAC.
**December 10, 2026, Australia:** automated decision making transparency obligations under the Privacy Act commence.
**January 1, 2027, United States:** the California Civil Rights Department's October 2025 FAQ gives this as the next training deadline.
**July 10, 2027, EU:** the AMLR applies directly in every Member State, so training policy, training and integrity assessment rows move to Articles 9, 12 and 13.

sections.heading: How does Knowledge Foundry approach this?

blocks.text: Knowledge Foundry maps each table 6 service a firm provides to the roles, decisions and assessment points involved, including scope tests and privilege calls, and records practitioner held duties such as CPD as verification points rather than courses. When a source such as the AMLR or AUSTRAC guidance changes, the affected practice groups can be traced from the framework. See [professional services](/industries/professional-services).

faqs.q: Do litigation teams need AML/CTF training?
faqs.a: AUSTRAC says litigation generally falls outside table 6, and items 1 and 2 do not apply to transactions under or resulting from a court or tribunal order. Litigators still need foundational awareness so they recognize when a matter drifts into a regulated service, such as a settlement that becomes a property transfer, and they keep their CPD, privacy and conduct rows.

faqs.q: Can firm AML training count toward a solicitor's CPD?
faqs.a: The matrix should treat them as separate obligations even when one session serves both. AML training is the firm's duty under the AML/CTF Rules; CPD is the solicitor's duty under the Uniform Rules, claimed in the solicitor's own record. Record which compulsory field a session was designed for, and leave the claim and declaration to the practitioner.

faqs.q: Does a small practice need a full matrix?
faqs.a: AUSTRAC's legal profession starter kit is designed for practices with 15 or fewer personnel that mostly serve Australian resident individuals and do not regularly deal with high risk clients. A practice outside those criteria cannot rely on the kit, and even a small practice still needs to show who was trained on what and when.

faqs.q: Can one AML module serve both an Australian and a Portuguese office?
faqs.a: A shared core on red flags and escalation can, but each market adds requirements. Portugal requires competent trainers, the compliance officer's prior favorable opinion and records kept seven years; Australia requires content appropriate to each person's function and the table 6 services they provide. Add market modules and record which module satisfies which rule.
